releases.name: v0.0.25
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* update new blast and spectrumAI by @DongdongdongW in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/79
* Spectrum ai by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/80
* Dev by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/82
* Spectrum ai by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/81
* disable cbioportal download test by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/83
* minor change in gitignore by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/85
* Fix misleading CLI help text for dnaseq-to-proteindb parameters by @Copilot in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/86
* Fix ValueError crash on incompatible COSMIC mutation records by @Copilot in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/88
* Fix incorrect amino acid sequences for minus-strand genes in vcf-to-proteindb by @Copilot in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/87
* Refactor/rename - First PR of a major refactoring by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/89
* Refactor/rename - move changes to support ClinVar and RefSeq  by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/91
* Major refactor of the database generation tool  by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/90
* Refactor/rename by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/92
* Refactor/rename remove improve the docs by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/93
* minor changes to the algorithms and bugs by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/95
* Docs and examples about how to use the library in different use cases by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/94
* Update README by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/96
* Update README by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/97
* perf(vcf-to-proteindb): per-chromosome multiprocessing (~3.4× on 4-chrom test) by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/104
* Bug-fix iteration: closes #98, #99, #100, #101 by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/102
* docs(cli): fix stale options, defaults, and examples in pgatk-cli.md by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/106
* chore: address CodeRabbit follow-up findings by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/107
* chore: address CodeRabbit + Copilot findings from PR #105 by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/108
* major refactoring and update for all the providers.  by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/105

## New Contributors
* @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/pull/86

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bigbio/pgatk/compare/v0.0.24...v0.0.25

releases.name: v0.0.24
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* update by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/69
* fixed bug in gtf file name, just keep version not release string by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/68
* add spectrumAI by @DongdongdongW in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/70
* Fix the bug of class-fdr, adjust the blast to multi-process running t… by @DongdongdongW in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/71
* fixes issue #72 by @husensofteng in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/73
* update validate by @DongdongdongW in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/76
* spectrumAI into py-pgatk by @ypriverol in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/77

## New Contributors
* @DongdongdongW made their first contribution in https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/pull/70

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bigbio/py-pgatk/compare/v0.0.23...v0.0.24
